function.name: permissions.Request
function.description: Request a capability grant for a tool method and a scope (usually a path), e.g. files.Write on /tmp/test.txt. Grants are cached for the rest of the session.

tool.description: The tool name the capability is requested for, e.g. "files".

method.description: The tool method the capability is requested for, e.g. "Write".

scope.description: The scope the capability is requested for, e.g. a path like "/tmp/test.txt".

function.name: permissions.List
function.description: List the capability grants that were requested during this session.
